title: Acceptance-maximizing input and proof
statement: Let $V$ be a PCPP system with Boolean inputs of positive length, proof length $L$, and a finite query count. Its optimal input-proof pair is a Boolean input and a Boolean proof of length $L$ whose acceptance probability under $V$ is maximal among all such pairs.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a PCPP system over Boolean symbols
